title: Audit full Toeplitz physical cuts through matching layers
body:
The full Toeplitz physical-cut implication needs a source-bound audit that handles unequal parallel children and zero-duration calls. This package proves the trace factorization by legal disjoint-support swaps and explicitly extends its algebraic coverage to arbitrary subsets of a matching gate layer. It retains all predecessor conditioning and child numerical contracts; it does not claim a new norm bound or selected κ.

The independent exact oracle binds the retained scheduler and one actual complex `Full` N=2 factory. It checks 191 cuts, including 64 proper partial-layer cuts, complete gate ownership, and four rejecting controls. Registered Python 3.12 normal/optimized replay, metadata/source pins, and committed-byte/source-history preflight, official export integrity, and Git-free normal/optimized replay pass.

Scope and proof are in `research/full-toeplitz-cut-audit/README.md`. The remaining numerical question is whether each child fragment bound also covers partial matching layers. No complete FFT historical replay, Lean, Docker or multiplication theorem acceptance is claimed.

Canonical claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4202#discussioncomment-19130763

Credit Jose Manuel for the retained rational compiler/physical-cut claim and Vlado for the original scheduler; source producer attribution is preserved. Prepared for Brian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Selected frontier unchanged.

Scoped search and live predecessor heads were rechecked; no competing result was identified in this stated coverage. Closed PR diffs, arbitrary nested code and unpublished work remain outside it.
